title: VANTA full release zip manifest
description: Describes one full release zip (VantaClient-<version>-Release.zip): the published files of one client release and one launcher release plus the repository documentation, bundled by .github/workflows/bundle.yml from the already published GitHub Release files. Stored in shared/releases/bundles/vanta-<version>.json, a folder the release-manifest readers (shared/releases/*.json) never see. file.downloadUrl, file.size and file.sha256 are filled in by the workflow from the real zip; an empty downloadUrl means 'not published yet'. contents lists every file inside the zip except its SHA256SUMS.txt, in zip order, with paths relative to the zip's top-level folder.

kind.description: Tells a bundle manifest from a release manifest. Always "bundle".

version.description: Version of the bundle (the tag is v<version>). Usually the version both products share.

clientVersion.description: Version of the bundled VANTA Client release (shared/releases/client-<clientVersion>.json).

launcherVersion.description: Version of the bundled VANTA Launcher release (shared/releases/launcher-<launcherVersion>.json).

minecraftVersion.description: Minecraft Java Edition version the bundled client targets (copied from the client manifest).

releaseDate.description: Date the zip was published as YYYY-MM-DD (UTC).

channel.description: stable when both component releases are stable, otherwise beta.

file.description: The zip itself as attached to the GitHub Release v<version>.

name.description: File name of the zip: VantaClient-<version>-Release.zip.

downloadUrl.description: Absolute https URL, or an empty string while the zip is not published.

size.description: Size of the zip in bytes (0 while unpublished).

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 digest of the zip, or an empty string while unpublished.

contents.description: Every file inside the zip except SHA256SUMS.txt, in zip order, paths relative to the top-level folder.

path.description: Path inside the top-level folder with '/' separators, no leading slash, no '.' or '..' segments (for example client/vanta-client-1.3.0.jar).

size.description: Uncompressed size in bytes. Every bundled file is non-empty.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 digest of the uncompressed file.
